summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the rdflib SPARQL plugin, as specified. Changes: Update class in sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py returns Update on every path (empty request builds prologue from q.prologue[0] with base and initNs, then returns empty algebra); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviors including a no-mutation check. Nothing was run (tests, black, installs were disallowed), so verification is by reading only. Nothing committed. Review point: the initial-bindings test uses an INSERT ... WHERE { } template and is the most likely to need adjustment once run.
